title: 第6章：父爱如山
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“小超。”

    “爸！”

    看着面前这个瘦骨嶙峋的男人，马超似乎所有的委屈都堵在了嗓子眼。

    比起父亲，他自己受到的这点委屈和不公又算的了什么，怕连父亲为了这个家所付出的十分之一都没有。

    他又有什么资格觉得委屈。

    “小超，是不是你妈为难你了，要不这腿咱就不治了，就是太委屈你，这么小的年纪，就要扛起养家的重担。”

    说到这里的时候，马建业眼眶都红了。

    他握住马超的手，“小超，你放心，爸不会成为你的拖累。”马建业眼里闪过一丝决绝。

    对马建业来说，他能在临死前见到大儿子一面，能跟大儿子说上话，就已经满足了。

    马超急了，“爸，你瞎说什么呢，这腿咱们必须治。”

    “可咱们家哪有这么多钱，就算你把玉佩要回来，卖了也不够填这无底洞。”

    马建业说的是事实。

    这年代要是让一个家庭背负八百元的负债，想都不敢去想，最好的办法其实就是断臂求生。

    只有马建业不成为家里的拖累，这个家里的日子才会一天天好起来。

    这也是马建业他这个当父亲的，最后能为这个家做的一点事。

    马超笑了笑，“爸，钱的事你就别操心了，我找到门路了，能挣钱，手术费用很快就能凑齐。”

    从父亲语气里，马超隐隐有了不好的预感，他现在获得了穿越到两界的能力，这点治疗费用，对于马超来说根本不算什么。

    即便马超没有这种能力，他也不会看着父亲去做傻事，纵使粉身碎骨，马超也不想让自己后悔一辈子。

    “什么挣钱门路？”

    “就算有门路，人家哪能要你一个半大孩子？”

    “爸不求别的，把你三个弟弟妹妹养大成人就行了。”

    马建业压根就不信，什么挣钱门路能挣到八百块钱。

    去偷？去抢？

    八百块钱放在80年代任何一个家庭，都不是一笔小钱。

    “小超，你可别去做坏事。”

    “爸，你想哪去了，我怎么会去干坏事。”

    “再说了，要是因为干坏事进去了，娟子，强子，莉莉，他们还那么小，让他们怎么活？”

    “你明白就好！”
content_en:
"Superboy."

    "Dad!"

    Looking at the skinny man in front of him, Ma Chao seemed to have all his grievances blocked in his throat.

    Compared to his father, the grievances and injustices he suffered were nothing. He was afraid that he did not even have one tenth of what his father had given to the family.

    What right did he have to feel aggrieved?

    "Xiaochao, is your mother giving you a hard time? Otherwise, we won't treat this leg. It's just too unfair for you. At such a young age, you have to shoulder the burden of supporting the family."

    When he said this, Ma Jianye's eyes turned red.

    He held Ma Chao's hand and said, "Xiao Chao, don't worry, dad won't be a burden to you." A trace of determination flashed in Ma Jianye's eyes.

    For Ma Jianye, it was enough for him to see and talk to his eldest son before he died.

    Ma Chao was anxious, "Dad, what are you talking about? We must treat this leg."

    "But our family doesn't have so much money. Even if you get the jade pendant back, selling it won't be enough to fill this bottomless pit."

    What Ma Jianye said is true.

    In this day and age, if a family is burdened with a debt of 800 yuan, it is unthinkable. The best way is to survive by cutting off an arm.

    As long as Ma Jianye does not become a drag on the family, the family's life will get better day by day.

    This is also the last thing Ma Jianye, a father, can do for the family.

    Ma Chao smiled and said, "Dad, don't worry about money. I have found a way to make money, and the surgery expenses will be collected soon."

    From his father's tone, Ma Chao had a vague premonition. He now had the ability to travel between two realms. The cost of treatment was nothing to Ma Chao.

    Even if Ma Chao does not have this ability, he will not watch his father do stupid things. Even if he is shattered to pieces, Ma Chao does not want to regret it for the rest of his life.

    "What's the way to make money?"

    "Even if you have the connections, how can anyone ask for your half-year-old child?"

    "Dad, I don't ask for anything else. I just want to raise your three younger brothers and sisters."

    Ma Jianye simply didn't believe that there was any way to make money that could earn 800 yuan.

    To steal? Go grab it?

    Eight hundred yuan was not a small amount of money for any family in the 1980s.

    "Xiaochao, don't do bad things."

    "Dad, where are you thinking? How could I do bad things?"

    "Besides, if they go in because of doing bad things, Juanzi, Qiangzi, and Lily are still so young, how can they survive?"

    "As long as you understand!"
title_en: Chapter 6: Father’s love is like a mountain
